ui_bugs.issue: Fuzzy ranking bug: typing '>run' surfaces '>run battery' ABOVE '>run benchmark'. Both labels start-with 'run ', so both hit the startsWith branch and get 700 + n.length*4 − (h.length−n.length)*0.1. Because 'run battery' (11 chars) is shorter than 'run benchmark' (13 chars), the length penalty gives battery a slightly higher score (711.2 vs 711.0). Spec requires benchmark first. Recommend: (a) remove the length penalty for startsWith matches, (b) OR tie-break on the command's original index in buildCommands so the natural order (benchmark defined before battery) is preserved, (c) OR boost commands whose action-verb has fewer characters after the prefix in a deterministic way (e.g. alphabetical).

rca of the issue: Cmd+K ranking bug — scoreMatch() line 159 subtracts a length-based penalty from the startsWith score. When two commands both start with the same word (e.g. 'run '), the shorter command wins by ~0.2 points, contradicting the spec's expected 'run benchmark' > 'run battery' order. Root cause: penalty was designed to favor tight matches, but it inadvertently ranks shorter labels above longer ones even when the prefix strength is identical. Fix: drop the length term from the startsWith branch, and add a stable secondary sort key (original command index) so ties preserve declaration order.
